title: Cross-Org Priority Handshake — Engineering All-Hands (Mar 17 2027)
content:
Purpose:
Quick cross-org alignment to lock top 6 priorities for the next 6 weeks, surface major risks, and agree on handoffs between serving-runtime, platform, SRE and product before the next sprint boundary. Keep short; capture action owners and blockers.

Attendees:
- Leadership: Aisha (host), Daniel (VP Serving), Marta (Platform), Ethan (SRE lead)
- Representatives: Priya (Observability), Omar (Private deploys), Sofia (Product-hosted API), Jay (Optimize)
- ~40 engineers on Zoom + recording (link in Confluence)

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins & top metrics (5m)
2) Priority list + owner callouts (15m)
3) Risk register + current incidents (5m)
4) Action items + next sync (5m)

Top metrics (reported by Priya) — snapshot (last 7d):
- Hosted API p50 gen latency: 120ms (steady), p95: 450ms (spike on long-seq requests)
- Dedicated cluster utilization: 73% average; autoscale events +2/day on busiest customers
- Token cost (avg per 1M tokens): $18 (optimizations starting to show)
- Error rate (5xx) for generation endpoints: 0.28% (baseline 0.3%)
- KV cache hit ratio for common prefixes: 62% (target >70%)
Notes: observed repeated p95 spikes correlated with mixed-batch sizes from mobile clients — followup with product + SDK team.

Priority list (finalized; owners named):
1) Reduce p95 tail for long-sequence workloads by 20% (owner: Daniel / serving-runtime)
   - Plan: kernel path gating to prefer fast quantized kernels for >2k tokens, temporary routing of long-seq to dedicated pools during peak.
   - Dependencies: infra capacity (Platform) + rollout policy tests (Product).
   - Risks: slight accuracy delta for some models — need eval set.

2) KV cache improvement sprint (owner: Jay / Optimize + Priya / Observability)
   - Deliverables: cache eviction improvements, telemetry for cache hot/shard imbalances, and tuning suggestions in Console.
   - Goal: raise cache hit ratio to 75% within 4 weeks.

3) Private deploys: air-gapped onboarding checklist + automated health probes (owner: Omar / Private Deploys)
   - Priority for two regulated customers with commit dates in April.

4) Autoscale stability: reduce noisy scale-ups and duplicate node allocation (owner: Marta / Platform)
   - Short-term: throttle duplicate reconcile calls; medium: refine demand signal.

5) Observability retention pilot (owner: Priya / Observability)
   - Pilot for token-level latency traces for VIP customers; 30-day retention for tracing.

6) Canary rollback automation (owner: Sofia / Product-hosted API)
   - Implement auto-fallback to prior model variant when quality regressions >3% on eval suite.

Team updates (3-min readouts):
- Serving-runtime (Daniel):
  - Completed PR to add dynamic kernel selection stub (GH-PR#5482). Integration tests green on internal bench but still failing an edge-case on long KV cache reads. Working w/ infra to reproduce.
  - Request: need 2 extra GPU nodes for a 48h soak in staging. Marta to approve.

- Platform (Marta):
  - Autoscaler patch queued (JIRA-INF-2027), initial rollout to canary pool tomorrow.
  - Capacity forecast: Q2 reserved commitments trending up 12%; buying strategy discussion next Tues.

- Observability (Priya):
  - Rolling out new trace ingest sampler to drop high-volume clients at 0.5% sample; expected telemetry cost delta -6%.
  - Working on dashboard to show end-to-end token cost by route.

- Private Deploys (Omar):
  - Finalizing air-gap install doc; still pending HSM test vectors from security (SEC-823).
  - Customer A will accept test cluster on Mar 29.

- Product / Hosted API (Sofia):
  - New route-level rollout UI prototype in Console; UX feedback loop with solutions-eng next week.

- SRE (Ethan):
  - Incident review: small memory leak in one model serving process (incident INC-3147). Root cause: delayed KV cache eviction on preempted pods. Mitigation: restart policy updated; long-term fix prioritized.
  - Follow-up: team to prepare RCA draft by Monday.

Open risks & discussion notes:
- Accuracy vs performance tradeoff for long-seq kernel routing: must prepare canned eval prompts and customer comms if we rollout fast-path kernels. (Owner: Research + Product)
- Capacity for soak tests: Platform needs to reassign two spot farms temporarily — blocking serving-runtime soak. (Owner: Marta)
- Observability cost increase if we increase trace retention for VIP customers — need precise cost model before commit. (Owner: Priya)

Decisions made in meeting:
- Approve short-term long-seq routing to dedicated pools for peak windows (20% of traffic) with telemetry gating for accuracy checks. (Decision owner: Daniel)
- Approve autoscaler patch canary tomorrow; platform to monitor and pause if duplicate nodes >1.5x during window. (Decision owner: Marta)

Action items (owner — due):
1) Daniel: schedule 48h soak for long-seq path in staging; request node budget from Marta (due: 2027-03-19).
2) Priya & Jay: rollout KV cache telemetry and draft tuning playbook; include sample queries (due: 2027-03-24).
3) Omar: publish air-gapped install checklist + schedule HSM test with Security (SEC-823) (due: 2027-03-22).
4) Marta: approve temporary spot node reallocation and monitor canary autoscaler (due: 2027-03-18).
5) Sofia: wire up canary rollback trigger to Console and add visual indicator for rollback events (due: 2027-03-25).
6) Ethan: publish RCA draft for INC-3147 and propose long-term eviction fix (due: 2027-03-21).

Notes-to-self / followups to capture in Confluence:
- Add dedicated eval prompt set for long-seq kernel validation (owner: Research).
- Add runbook snippet for manual rollback when automated fallback misses (owner: SRE).
- Cross-link GH-PR#5482 and JIRA-INF-2027 in the final all-hands summary.

FAQ / Q&A highlights (paraphrased):
Q: Will routing long-seq to dedicated pools increase cost for customers?
A: Potentially for peak windows; product will expose a cost delta estimate per route before GA.

Q: How will we communicate to customers if model latency improves but small accuracy delta appears?
A: Product + Solutions will coordinate a staged comms plan and flag customers with closed-loop evals first.

Next sync: 2027-03-31 (30 min) — follow status on action items and decide go/no-go for broad rollout.

Editors: Aisha P., Daniel K., Priya S.
